form.title: OMOP QC and identifier screening
form.description: Checks file structure before screening for identifiers. A structural QC failure stops the run. Direct identifiers quarantine the batch; dates, ZIP codes and free text are reported for later steps. Source data stays unchanged.

provider_policy.title: Clinician and site identity
provider_policy.description: From the source register: stop treats clinician and site names and identifiers (provider, care_site) as direct identifiers; review reports them for a curator.

research_id_pattern.title: Research ID pattern
research_id_pattern.description: Regular expression every person_source_value must match (from the source register). Empty: person_source_value is reported for review.
